add_channelz_servicer: add the Channelz debug servicer to a gRPC server to enable runtime introspection queries
GetTopChannels: list all top-level gRPC channels in the process starting from a given channel ID
GetServers: list all gRPC servers in the process starting from a given server ID
GetChannel: retrieve detailed information about a specific gRPC channel by its channel ID
GetServer: retrieve detailed information about a specific gRPC server by its server ID
